Employer:	Royal 3PL Pty Ltd t/a Northedge Cabinets and Cladding
Position: 	Office Manager 
Salary: 	       $76,000 – $85,000 Plus Superannuation
Location: 	36 Highlander Dr. Craigieburn VIC 3064
Mode: 		Full-Time
Experience:	1 year experience
Royal 3PL Pty Ltd trading as Northedge Cabinets and Cladding, is an Australian-owned company specialising in the design, manufacture, supply, and installation of premium cabinetry and architectural cladding solutions. The company delivers high-quality products and services to residential, commercial, and multi-unit developments across Australia, working closely with builders, developers, architects, designers, and private clients.
Northedge Cabinets and Cladding provides customised joinery and cabinetry solutions for kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes, laundries, offices, and other interior spaces, together with innovative cladding systems that enhance the functionality and visual appeal of modern buildings. The company is committed to delivering tailored solutions that meet each client's design requirements while maintaining exceptional standards of workmanship, quality, and customer service.
The business manages projects from initial consultation and design through to manufacturing, project coordination, delivery, and installation. By integrating skilled craftsmanship with efficient project management and modern manufacturing techniques, Northedge Cabinets and Cladding ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest industry standards.
As the company continues to expand its operations and undertake an increasing number of residential and commercial projects, it has experienced significant growth in its administrative and operational requirements. This growth has created the need for dedicated management of office operations, customer communications, project administration, supplier coordination, procurement activities, and internal business processes.
To support the continued expansion of the business, Royal 3PL Pty Ltd requires a skilled Office Manager to oversee the company's administrative functions, coordinate office operations, streamline internal processes, and provide essential support to management, production, installation teams, suppliers, and clients. The position plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the business while enabling the company to maintain its high standards of service delivery and support its future growth objectives.
Key Responsibilities:

•	Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operations of the office to ensure efficient workflow and business continuity.
•	Develop, implement and maintain office procedures, administrative systems and record management processes to improve operational efficiency.
•	Coordinate incoming customer enquiries, prepare quotations, maintain job files and ensure project documentation is complete and up to date.
•	Liaise with clients, builders, suppliers and subcontractors regarding project schedules, material deliveries, installation dates and administrative requirements.
•	Prepare and process purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices and related administrative documentation.
•	Monitor office expenditure, maintain financial records and assist management with budget tracking and monthly administrative reports.
•	Coordinate procurement of office supplies and monitor stock of administrative and operational consumables.
•	Maintain accurate records of contracts, supplier agreements, project documentation and company compliance documents.
•	Coordinate staff rosters, leave records, timesheets and other human resources administration activities.
•	Ensure office operations comply with company policies, workplace health and safety procedures and relevant legislative requirements.
•	Prepare regular administrative and operational reports for management to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Identify opportunities to improve office procedures and implement administrative process improvements to enhance productivity and customer service.
•	Provide administrative support to senior management and coordinate communication between office staff, production personnel and installation teams to ensure projects progress efficiently.
	
To be successful in this role, you must have:

•	A relevant qualification in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
•	At least one year of relevant experience in an office management, administration, or operations coordination role (or as otherwise required under the relevant visa or company policy).
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, document management, and business operations.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills with the ability to coordinate and support administrative staff.
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise professionally with clients, suppliers, contractors, and internal teams.

result.description:
La Riviera Dining
Wine & Dine Australia Pty Ltd, trading as Bambini Trust Restaurant
Sydney NSW 2000

Café or Restaurant Manager
Full Time Role
Salary Range $77,000 to $80,000 per annum, plus superannuation.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
1. Operational Management
•	Coordinate daily front-of-house operations, including service setup, staff briefings, and shift supervision. 
•	Ensure smooth collaboration between front-of-house and kitchen teams. 
•	Maintain service standards consistent with the La Riviera brand. 
•	Monitor and improve operational procedures to ensure efficient restaurant operations and high levels of customer satisfaction. 
2. Staff Leadership and Development
•	Coordinate staff recruitment, onboarding and performance management processes. 
•	Plan and deliver training programs focused on guest service, product knowledge and teamwork. 
•	Contribute to building a positive and high-performing workplace culture. 
•	Prepare staff rosters and supervise staff to ensure adequate staffing levels during operating hours. 
3. Guest Experience and Customer Service
•	Manage reservations, guest interactions and special requests. 
•	Handle feedback and complaints with professionalism and discretion. 
•	Participate in the delivery of VIP and high-profile guest experiences. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and implement service improvements to enhance the overall guest experience. 
4. Wine Room and Beverage Coordination
•	Work alongside the Sommelier to oversee wine service, pairing and cellar management. 
•	Coordinate wine and beverage training for staff. 
•	Manage inventory checks and beverage ordering. 
•	Monitor beverage stock levels and ensure appropriate inventory control procedures are maintained. 
5. Financial and Administrative Support
•	Monitor sales performance and implement cost control measures. 
•	Oversee the use of point-of-sale and booking systems. 
•	Manage back-office administrative functions, including timesheet collection and supplier invoicing. 
•	Assist in preparing operational reports and monitoring labour costs to support business profitability. 
6. Compliance and Workplace Safety
•	Ensure compliance with NSW food safety and liquor licensing laws. 
•	Conduct risk assessments and implement workplace health and safety initiatives. 
•	Ensure safe service practices are followed during operations and events. 
•	Monitor compliance with company policies and relevant legislative requirements. 
7. Supplier and Inventory Management
•	Manage stock ordering, deliveries and supplier communications. 
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and identify opportunities to minimise waste. 
•	Ensure quality control of incoming goods and supplies. 
•	Maintain appropriate stock levels to support uninterrupted restaurant operations. 
8. Events and Marketing Support
•	Contribute to the planning and execution of events, such as private dinners and cocktail functions. 
•	Coordinate the promotion of wine tastings, seasonal menus and customer engagement activities. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and participate in continuous improvement discussions. 
•	Work with management to implement promotional initiatives that enhance customer engagement and increase revenue. 


Qualifications
•	A relevant qualification in Hospitality Management, Restaurant Management, Business Management or a related field (such as an AQF Certificate IV, Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management) is desirable. 
•	Alternatively, at least three years of relevant full-time industry experience in restaurant or hospitality management may substitute for formal qualifications, where applicable. 
•	Current Food Safety Supervisor Certificate (or the ability to obtain one). 
•	Current Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) Certificate. 
•	First Aid Certificate is desirable. 

Work Experience
•	At least two years of full-time experience in a managerial role, or three years of relevant experience, in a café, restaurant or similar hospitality establishment. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing the day-to-day operations of a restaurant or café, including front-of-house operations. 
•	Experience recruiting, supervising, training and managing the performance of staff. 
•	Experience managing customer service, resolving guest complaints and maintaining high service standards. 
•	Experience preparing staff rosters, managing inventory, ordering supplies and maintaining stock control. 
•	Experience monitoring food quality, operational efficiency and compliance with food safety and workplace health and safety requirements. 
•	Experience monitoring budgets, labour costs, sales performance and implementing cost control measures. 
•	Experience coordinating private functions, special events or promotional activities is desirable. 
•	Sound knowledge of Australian hospitality legislation, food safety standards and liquor licensing requirements.


How to apply:
Applications open on 21 July 2026 and close on 20 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Position: Sales and Marketing Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: Sawari Motors
Location: Cannington WA 6107
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Sawari Motors is a dynamic automotive business specialising in car rentals, sales, repairs, and innovative rent-to-own programs. Based in Beckenham, Perth, we provide reliable, Uber-approved vehicles—including sedans, hybrids, and premium models—to meet diverse customer needs for daily commutes, business travel, and rideshare opportunities. Renowned for our customer-focused approach, quality service, and flexible solutions that help clients achieve vehicle ownership with minimal upfront costs, we pride ourselves on trust, affordability, and excellence. Our supportive team environment values innovation, collaboration, and a passion for mobility, fostering a workplace where professional growth and outstanding customer experiences go hand in hand.
About the Position:
The Sales and Marketing Manager plays a pivotal role at Sawari Motors, leading the development and execution of strategies to drive vehicle sales, rentals, and rent-to-own uptake. This position oversees marketing campaigns, sales team performance, market analysis, and customer relationships to expand our market presence in Perth’s competitive automotive sector. By aligning sales initiatives with business goals, the role is essential for achieving revenue targets, enhancing brand visibility, and supporting the company’s growth in rentals, sales, and customer-centric services.
Key Responsibilities:
Formulating, directing and coordinating the Company's vehicle sales and marketing strategies, policies and plans.
Directing the development of sales initiatives, setting sales targets, and monitoring the performance of the sales team against budgets and targets.
Planning and managing marketing campaigns, advertising, digital marketing, social media presence and promotional activities for the dealership.
Undertaking market research and analysis of consumer demand, market trends, competitor activity and pricing to identify sales opportunities.
Determining pricing strategies, discount structures and trade-in policies in conjunction with management.
Managing relationships with key customers, suppliers, finance providers and other business partners.
Overseeing vehicle stock acquisition and inventory planning to align with sales forecasts and customer demand.
Recruiting, training, supervising and appraising sales staff and managing the day-to-day operation of the sales department.
Preparing and presenting sales and marketing reports, forecasts and budgets to management.
Ensuring all sales and marketing activities comply with applicable laws, including the Australian Consumer Law and Western Australian motor vehicle dealer licensing requirements.
Performing other duties consistent with the position as reasonably directed by the employer.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Bachelor’s degree in Business or Marketing.
Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience.
Proven skills in developing and executing sales and marketing strategies, including digital marketing, social media, and campaign management.
Strong analytical abilities for market research, competitor analysis, and performance monitoring.
Excellent interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal teams.
Leadership experience in recruiting, training, and supervising sales teams.
Knowledge of automotive industry trends, pricing strategies, and compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., Australian Consumer Law).
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Trading under Publicis Communications Australia

Planner (Also known as Strategist, Strategy Planner)
Your job is to devise brilliant communication strategies for your clients, that provide the foundations for exceptional creative advertising. You will be expert at gathering the relevant knowledge and insight to write great briefs – including trend research, data interpretation and conducting your own research, both qualitative and quantitative. You need to bring inspiration, clarity of thought and passion to your briefs. Reporting to Senior Planner, you must demonstrate impeccable communication skills as you will regularly be required to present your work with a convincing and compelling presentation style and impressive skills with PowerPoint/other presentation tools. You’ll also be able to build solid relationships with creative, account management and clients, show initiative and work independently. Day to day, you will write thoughtful and inspiring briefs, brief creative teams, manage and conduct quantitative and qualitative research, write research debriefs for clients and internal audiences and work with your account teams on competitive analysis and POVs on relevant markets.  

Salary - $85k - $105k package


Senior Planner (Also known as Senior Strategist, Senior Strategy Planner, Associate Planning Director)

This role is suited to someone with 4+ years’ experience in a strategy role or equivalent role in which business rigour, creative inspiration and human insight collide. The focus of the role is to be a strategic leader in the business, responsible for developing brilliant strategic solutions for your accounts and on new business. Helping your clients to define and overcome business and brand problems and harness the opportunities presented. You will act as the client go to on all things customer, category and culture by being on top of the latest trends and innovations. You’ll demonstrate strong communication, relationship and people management skills. You will write clear and concise presentations. You’ll be confident with both qualitative and quantitative research technique (interpretation and preferably ability to lead/facilitate) and you’ll have an appetite for learning new skills and tools – including techniques such as UX/CX. 
Salary – Over Threshold 
 

Planning Director (Also known as Strategy Director)
We’re looking for a Planning Director to join our team. The Planning Director is the visionary leader across their client portfolio. They are responsible for anticipating and driving the long-term issues that will add value by way of fresh and insightful perspective regarding the consumer and their relationships to the brand. You will develop strategic direction for your allocated client which reflect our vision to provide unique creative led solutions to their brand, business and communications challenges.  You will build rapport with both the agency and the clients’ business so as to cement relationships on all levels and become a central part of the agency’s offering and products.  We are looking for a strong strategic leader to bring a new dimension of strategic quality to the agency’s core offering and provide better services to the current clients. Desired Skills and Experience include: Creative Strategy, Brand Marketing and Innovation, Digital, Data and Technology Skills, Customer Experience, Problem Solving, Behavioural Insights.
Salary – Over Threshold 


All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

What We Are Looking For

•	Minimum 1 years of full-time or part-time equivalent experience as a Chef De Partie, or strong Demi Chef ready to step up
•	A relevant and acceptable trade qualification or apprenticeship or at least 2 years of experience in lieu 
•	Strong cooking skills and sound knowledge of kitchen operations
•	Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a busy service environment
•	Good organisational skills and attention to detail
•	Reliable, professional, and committed to consistent standards
•	A practical, hands-on approach and willingness to work as part of a team

What We Offer

•	A Competitive remuneration between $79,500 to $85,000 plus super, based on experience
•	Stable, well-established venue with consistent trade
•	Supportive senior kitchen team and professional working environment
•	Opportunity to develop your skills and grow with the business

If you take pride in well-executed food, work well under pressure, and value consistency over shortcuts, we would like to hear from you.
How to apply:

Applications open on 7 July 2026 and close on 6 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.
